verification.scope: Execution and contract checks; business ambiguities require operator answers

notes: SKU values are zero-padded text in the source ('00470001'); the profiling typed the column as int, so it must be cast to string with the original digits, never re-derived from a float.

Every SKU appears twice, once for Location KUL and once for JHB: the table must be exploded into /prices (one record per SKU, with price_list 'standard') and /inventory (two records per SKU, identity key warehouse_code).
Tax facts come from the file, not from convention: Tax included = 'No' (vat_included false) and Tax rate = '5%' (0.05). The 5% is a fixture value; the schema default 0.07 does not apply.
Currency is a single explicit source value MYR on all rows; no FX conversion is performed and no currency is assumed from the warehouse codes.
No pack-size column exists, so /unit/pack_size stays null; no reserved/allocated column exists, so /inventory/*/reserved stays null - both are unknown, not zero.
No status, barcode, category, brand, description or promotion columns exist in this export; those target fields remain unpopulated rather than being filled with invented constants.

Warehouse codes KUL and JHB are used verbatim as warehouse_code; whether they are physical warehouses, branches or sales regions is not stated in the file and does not change their use as the inventory identity key.

tables.reason: Sheet 'inventory_export' holds one row per SKU per Location (12 distinct SKUs x 24 rows, every SKU appears exactly twice; Available is unique per row, 10-41). The row grain is SKU x warehouse, which is the inventory grain, so the inventory columns are the primary content; the same table also carries one price-list row per SKU (Currency MYR, Price list 'standard', Net price, Tax included 'No', Tax rate 5%) that feeds /prices.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header 'SKU' matches the identity key synonym list; top_values show zero-padded text '00470001'..'00470012' although the type detector coerced to int (min 470001) - must be read as text to preserve the leading zeros.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header 'Product name' is a direct synonym of /product_name; 12 distinct values, one per SKU (SIM care 1..12), no empty cells.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Header 'Currency' is a direct synonym; single distinct ISO code 'MYR' across all 24 rows, so it is a row-constant value not a guess.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header 'Sales unit' is a /unit/sell_unit synonym; single value 'PCS' which is in the target enum_hint, and unit_normalize maps it to PCS.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header 'Price list' is a /prices/*/price_list synonym; the only value is 'standard', matching the contract default and the operator note to use 'standard' where explicitly stated.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header 'Net price' appears in the /prices/*/amount synonym list ('net price'); 12 distinct decimals 1234.56-1356.77, never empty, one value per SKU, so it is the selling price amount rather than a cost or extended total.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Header 'Tax included' with the explicit source value 'No' in all 24 rows: the net price is VAT-exclusive, so vat_included = false. This is stated in the file, not inferred from the country.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header 'Tax rate' with explicit value '5%' in every row (percent hint); stored as a fraction 0.05 via parse_number_th with percent_to_fraction. Explicit source rate, so the schema default 0.07 must not be applied.

columns.name: Location
columns.reason: Header 'Location' is listed as a /inventory/*/warehouse_code synonym; two distinct site codes KUL and JHB, each on exactly 12 rows, which partitions each SKU into two stock records.

columns.name: Available
columns.reason: Header 'Available' is a /inventory/*/qty synonym ('available'); 24 distinct integers 10-41, one per SKU x Location row. It is stock quantity, not a key, despite the key-candidate heuristic flagging it (it is unique only because the sample is small).

changes_from_draft: Added root record dedupe on /sku (keep first): the source has 24 rows = 12 SKUs × 2 Locations, so without it each SKU would emit two duplicate product records.

/prices/*/price_list now maps the explicit source column 'Price list' (value 'standard') instead of a hardcoded constant.
/prices/*/vat_included now parses the explicit source column 'Tax included' ('No' → false) instead of a hardcoded constant.
Added /prices/*/vat_rate = parse_number_th('Tax rate', percent_to_fraction=true) → 0.05 from the explicit 5% source value; the schema default 0.07 is deliberately not applied.
Added the missing /inventory collection: warehouse_code from 'Location' (KUL/JHB) and qty from 'Available', deduped by warehouse_code, giving two stock entries per product.
Added /prices dedupe_keys ['/price_list'] so the identical SKU-level price row repeated for KUL and JHB collapses to a single price entry.
Tightened quality rules: /sku unique and not_null as errors, currency ISO-3 regex, price positive, inventory qty not_null.
attributes_passthrough disabled because every source column (SKU, Product name, Currency, Sales unit, Price list, Net price, Tax included, Tax rate, Location, Available) is already mapped.

No status, barcode, category, brand, description, pack_size, reserved or promotion source exists; those optional targets stay unpopulated (schema default status 'active' applies) rather than being invented.
